assets.name: Пустая ячейка
assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: empty backpack cell placeholder icon in DnD Share.
Input image 1: edit target, the existing open empty leather pouch.
Primary request: change ONLY its color palette and simplify its shading. Make the pouch much more uniform and neutral gray, with a medium-gray exterior, slightly darker gray inner opening, and a charcoal-gray outline and cords. Use only three broad neutral gray tones plus the outline. Remove beige, brown, gold and purple color casts, all warm highlights, glossy highlights, gradients and most small fold shading. Keep a quiet matte flat-cartoon appearance readable at 64x64.
Invariants: preserve the exact recognizable silhouette, proportions, opening, drawstrings, camera angle, pose, centered composition and padding. Keep the bag clearly OPEN and EMPTY. Do not add, remove or rearrange any structural part. Keep the transparent alpha background. No backdrop, tile, shadow, text, frame or new object.
